title: Is punting legal in girls flag football?
short: Is punting legal in girls flag football?
desc: Yes, but you have to declare it first. The 5-second rule, and what happens to the ball.
alt: A girls flag football player punting the ball

title: Can you keep the ball after scoring in flag football?
short: Can you keep the ball after scoring in flag football?
desc: Yes, if you're still behind. Fourth down at your own 20. New for 2026–27.
alt: A girls flag football player holding the ball

title: Do you have to declare a punt in flag football?
short: Do you have to declare a punt in flag football?
desc: Yes. Tell the referee first, and once it's declared you have to kick. 5 seconds after the snap.
alt: A girls flag football player punting the ball

title: What happens if your flag belt falls off?
short: What happens if your flag belt falls off?
desc: The play keeps going. A one-hand touch between the shoulders and knees ends it.
alt: A girls flag football player running with the ball

title: What is flag guarding in flag football?
short: What is flag guarding in flag football?
desc: The runner can't use her hand, arm or the ball to fight off a defender. 10 yards, signal 38.
alt: A girls flag football player running, one arm out
